transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: Hello! What does democracy mean to you personally?

transcript.speaker: respondent
transcript.text: Democracy is good, of course. It's the best system.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: What do you mean when you say it's the best?

transcript.speaker: respondent
transcript.text: I don't know, it's just better than the alternatives.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: Would you accept a strong leader who doesn't need parliament if problems got solved faster?

transcript.speaker: respondent
transcript.text: Honestly yes, if he delivers results and gets things done. Parliament is just endless talking, we need order and stability.
